referrals.source_fact: The source explicitly names Tris hydrochloride. Sigma T3253 establishes CAS1185-53-1, formula tris·HCl and molecular weight157.60, distinct from free tris CHEBI:9754 (121.136) and Htris cation CHEBI:46097 (no chloride). Current Tris_Base active hydrochloride aliases erase this salt boundary and should be rejected as resolving base synonyms.
